summary: No target was selected and none was prepared. What exists is the part of gap 8 that is decidable without spending: the extended reservation set, derived by rule from the six files that publish it - 79 pull requests, of which 28 are the revealed inventory's candidate rows - and the mechanical criteria E1, E2, E3 and E5 implemented as a checker and exercised against the live forge. The freshness threshold is recomputed for a 2026-09-12 freeze as 2026-03-12.
establishes: gap 8's derivation requirement - the reservation set grows by rule and not by hand, and it is reproducible from the repository - and the mechanical half of the criteria. Nothing about any target.
residual: Selection was not performed, and the reason is the specification's own ordering rather than an oversight: its README puts runtime requalification before fresh targets and says an unsupported or unobservable control stops the study, and P16 did not establish an isolation regime a cell can run under. Preparing and sealing four targets - each needing an adjudicator and a selector session, both charged - for a study that is stopped would spend the pre-freeze subtotal on inputs no dispatch can consume. What remains, per target, is #148 section 9 in full: pins; the truncated mirror with negative leak-set checks on the mirror and every clone; the packet build with its recorded cutoff; offline provisioning and one focused base and head command; adjudication by a fresh helper with the register and leak set sealed; one selector run frozen as delivered; and the manifest. Before any of that, the curator's hunt has to produce a sealed candidate inventory covering E4 and E6 to E10, which only the curator can decide. One shelf-life note for whoever resumes: E2's threshold moves with the freeze's 'today', so an inventory frozen now expires; recompute it rather than inheriting this one.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
